scope: Complete real 30-second all-effect five-member input packing, default growth/no cube and all favorite stages; GPU admission and battle certification remain unproven.

classification.method: Independent lowered definition validation plus complete program packing
classification.reference_readiness_scope: Conservative recorded native prerequisites; not runtime validation, exhaustive semantics or GPU support

reference_readiness.note: The pinned specification explicitly leaves destructible enemy projectiles and enemy shields unimplemented. all_projectiles returns before damage handling; these modifiers have no canonical damage-factor consumer. A private v1 CPU/Metal scalar contract adds the explicitly declared target-kind contribution inside factor5 before final rounding; the scalar probe itself is not a battle producer and does not certify in-game rules. Separate opt-in plain projectile, HP-shield and hit-credit skill bindings are recorded when applicable; their scopes do not establish weapon or piercing interception. This remains missing reference semantics, never no-op GPU support. Historical decisions are evidence, not instructions to omit the current goal

Explicit attack groups count distinct typed targets; the default battle does not open/seal these groups and publishes default attack_id0. Pellet count, total damage or manual group tests cannot replace a real producer. An opt-in CPU producer now captures actual normal-shot returns and body/add landings under declared all-logical-enemies routing, including nonzero original children and frozen generations; see reference attack-group-battle. This routing is not verified game geometry. Shared Slang now connects owned physical-shot groups, frozen queued children and current-target buffs under this explicit policy; Metal32 including ADD quantities and rejected inputs is independently verified. Default admission, broader geometry and current CUDA remain closed A separate native-routing policy now uses the existing physical selector for every pellet, including sequential ADD destruction within one real SG shot. Metal53 is independently audited; the extra20 cases preserve native routing and16 unchanged full battles. This does not certify geometry or install the default producer.
